posts.body:
Hi There 

I am expecting twins in April 2015 and will relocate from Singapore to Hong Kong to join my Husband.

We are wanting to hire a qualified Nanny to look after the twins from July 2015 (when they are approx 3-4 months old) when I return to work.

Are qualified nannies available in Hong Kong? If so can anyone recommend an agency I can contact 

We will also like to hire a live in helper to run the house 

Thanks in advance for your help

Sent from my iPhone using GeoClicks

posts.body: Maybe look at rent-a-mum.com website if wanting western/English speaking childcare /nanny. They have a range of services on offer. Not cheap though!
